image.head: Generate a still IMAGE (a single photograph, not a video). One single picture, not a collage, grid or split frame:
image.realism: Realistic landscape photograph, looks like a real place shot on a full-frame camera with a {lens}, true-to-life materials and textures, accurate real-world scale and proportions. Muted natural color grading like a calm documentary photo: greens are deep and slightly desaturated, never lime or neon; gentle contrast, no HDR look, no oversharpening. Bare rock, water and grass show irregular natural detail, slightly soft like an unprocessed camera file, never a repeating crosshatch or woven pattern. Autumn foliage reads as muted copper, rust and ochre, never saturated orange or red.

look.interior-bright: Bright natural daylight with lifted shadows and clear detail, never murky or crushed.
look.day: Soft daylight under thin high cloud, balanced exposure with detail in both highlights and shadows, no harsh midday sun.
look.misty: Cool diffused daylight through thin mountain mist, gentle contrast and clear readable layers.
look.golden: Low warm golden-hour light in muted gold and soft amber tones under a pale sky, long soft shadows, restrained saturation and highlights, never a blazing orange sky.
look.overcast: Quiet bright overcast daylight, soft shadows, muted contrast and natural colors.
look.dawn: Early morning light with a pale cool sky and a subtle warm glow near the horizon, never a painted sunrise.
look.after-rain: Soft light just after rain, damp natural surfaces and gentle reflections, subdued colors, without dramatic storm clouds.

image.lights: Natural light only: believable sun, sky light and soft reflections from the landscape; no artificial glow, fantasy beams or floating sparkles.
image.motion_ready: Clearly visible and physically plausible in the frame: {motion_elements}.
image.clean: The place is unoccupied: no people, human figures or silhouettes, no animals, birds, vehicles, signs, text, numbers, logos or brand marks; all rocks, trees, water and architecture have believable real-world geometry.
image.tail: Sharp focus, a single 16:9 landscape photograph, clean edges and natural photographic depth.

season.summer: It is midsummer: every leaf, tree, fern, heather and grass blade is fresh green, with no yellow, orange, red or brown foliage anywhere and no snow except on the highest far peaks.
season.autumn: It is autumn: the foliage shows natural autumn colors, gentle and true to life, never neon or oversaturated.
season.late-snow: It is late winter going into spring: old snow lies in patches, with bare ground and pale grass showing between them.
season.early-snow: It is early winter: a thin first snow lies unevenly, with grass, rock and earth showing through in many places.
season.winter-edge: It is the edge of winter: frost and thin ice, pale dry grass and bare branches, with very little snow.
